scope: five synthetic production PromptPlanner cases, local PostgreSQL/Ollama, one bounded call per case, no cloud requests
decision: Experimental prompt changes reverted; model configuration unchanged. Explicit omission guard added and verified separately. Semantic quality acceptance remains failing.
limitations: Small corpus does not establish general model rankings.
Guard tests prove known missing-cue pauses, not full semantic accuracy.
Optional corpus is skipped in ordinary offline runs.
